moi-gp-all-profiles-details-v1.CL_person_full_name_en: Full name in English. Use match query. Example: {"match": {"CL_person_full_name_en": "Ahmed"}}
moi-gp-all-profiles-details-v1.prs_gdr: Gender. Keyword field. Values are EXACTLY 'Male' or 'Female'. Example: {"term": {"prs_gdr": "Male"}}
moi-gp-all-profiles-details-v1.prs_dob: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD string. Use range query. Example for born after 1980: {"range": {"prs_dob": {"gte": "1980-01-01"}}}
moi-gp-all-profiles-details-v1.person_natcde: Nationality. Use the NATIONALITY NAME directly (e.g. 'Qatari', 'Pakistani', 'Indian'). Example for Qatari: {"term": {"person_natcde": "Qatari"}}. Example for Pakistani: {"term": {"person_natcde": "Pakistani"}}

moi-vehicle-info-v1.MNF_ENSHDESC: Vehicle MAKE (manufacturer). Text field. Values are UPPERCASE: 'TOYOTA', 'NISSAN', 'BMW', 'KIA'. Example for Toyota: {"match": {"MNF_ENSHDESC": "TOYOTA"}}
moi-vehicle-info-v1.VEH_MODEL: Vehicle MODEL (e.g. CAMRY, PATROL, X5). Text field. Use only when model name is specified. Example: {"match": {"VEH_MODEL": "CAMRY"}}
moi-vehicle-info-v1.VEH_MODELYEAR: Year as 4-digit string. Text field. Example: {"term": {"VEH_MODELYEAR": "2022"}}
moi-vehicle-info-v1.CLR_CLRENGDSC: Color. Text field. Values are UPPERCASE: 'WHITE', 'BLACK', 'SILVER'. Example: {"match": {"CLR_CLRENGDSC": "WHITE"}}
moi-vehicle-info-v1.VRG_STATUS: Registration status. Text field. 'ACT'=active, 'EXP'=expired. Example active: {"match": {"VRG_STATUS": "ACT"}}
moi-vehicle-info-v1.VRG_ENDDT: Registration expiry date. Date field. Example expired before 2024: {"range": {"VRG_ENDDT": {"lt": "2024-01-01"}}}
moi-vehicle-info-v1.VRG_STADTE: Registration start date. Date field. Example registered in 2022: {"range": {"VRG_STADTE": {"gte": "2022-01-01", "lte": "2022-12-31"}}}
moi-vehicle-info-v1.VRG_OWNQID: Owner Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.

moi-violations-v1.VLN_TYPE: Violation type. Keyword field. Values EXACTLY: 'SPEEDING', 'RED_LIGHT', 'PARKING', 'SEATBELT', 'MOBILE_PHONE'. Example: {"term": {"VLN_TYPE": "SPEEDING"}}
moi-violations-v1.VLN_STATUS: Payment status. Keyword field. Values EXACTLY: 'PAID' or 'UNPAID'. Example: {"term": {"VLN_STATUS": "UNPAID"}}
moi-violations-v1.VLN_PLCDSC: Road/location name. Keyword field. Values: 'CORNICHE ROAD', 'AL WAAB STREET', 'SALWA ROAD', 'AL RAYYAN ROAD', 'AL SADD STREET'. Example: {"term": {"VLN_PLCDSC": "CORNICHE ROAD"}}
moi-violations-v1.VLN_TOTAMT: Fine amount in QAR. Float field. Example over 1000: {"range": {"VLN_TOTAMT": {"gt": 1000}}}
moi-violations-v1.VLN_DATE_DATE: Date of violation YYYY-MM-DD. Date field. Example in 2024: {"range": {"VLN_DATE_DATE": {"gte": "2024-01-01", "lte": "2024-12-31"}}}
moi-violations-v1.VLN_YEAR: Year as string. Keyword field. Example: {"term": {"VLN_YEAR": "2024"}}
moi-violations-v1.VLN_PLTNUM: Plate number of vehicle in violation. Keyword field.
moi-violations-v1.VLN_OWNQID: Owner Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.

moi-exit-entry-tts-details-v1.TRX_QIDNO: Traveller Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.
moi-exit-entry-tts-details-v1.TRX_DIRECTION: Travel direction. Text field. Values: 'IN' (entry) or 'OUT' (exit). Example entry: {"match": {"TRX_DIRECTION": "IN"}}
moi-exit-entry-tts-details-v1.TRX_TYPE_DESC: Transaction description. Values: 'ENTRY TRANSACTION' or 'EXIT TRANSACTION'. Example: {"match": {"TRX_TYPE_DESC": "EXIT TRANSACTION"}}
moi-exit-entry-tts-details-v1.TRX_DATE: Date of travel. Date field. Example in 2024: {"range": {"TRX_DATE": {"gte": "2024-01-01", "lte": "2024-12-31"}}}
moi-exit-entry-tts-details-v1.BORDER_CODE_DESC: Border crossing point. Text field. Values: 'HAMAD INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT', 'ABU SAMRA BORDER', 'SALWA BORDER', 'DOHA PORT'. Example: {"match": {"BORDER_CODE_DESC": "HAMAD INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT"}}
moi-exit-entry-tts-details-v1.TRX_TRIP_TYP_DESC: Travel mode. Text field. Values: 'FLIGHT', 'LAND', 'SEA'. Example: {"match": {"TRX_TRIP_TYP_DESC": "FLIGHT"}}

moi-visa-main-details-v1.HLD_QIDNO: Visa holder Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.
moi-visa-main-details-v1.VISA_TYPE_DESC: Visa type description. Text field. Values: 'Work Visa', 'Visit Visa', 'Residence Permit', 'Family Visa', 'Student Visa'. Example: {"match": {"VISA_TYPE_DESC": "Work Visa"}}
moi-visa-main-details-v1.VSA_TYPCDE: Visa type code. Text field. '40'=Work Visa, '11'=Visit Visa, '20'=Residence Permit, '35'=Family Visa, '50'=Student Visa.
moi-visa-main-details-v1.VSA_ISSDTE: Visa issue date. Date field. Example issued in 2022: {"range": {"VSA_ISSDTE": {"gte": "2022-01-01", "lte": "2022-12-31"}}}
moi-visa-main-details-v1.VSA_EXPDTE: Visa expiry date. Date field. Example expiring before 2025: {"range": {"VSA_EXPDTE": {"lt": "2025-01-01"}}}
moi-visa-main-details-v1.NAT_CDENUM: Holder nationality. Use nationality NAME (e.g. 'Qatari', 'Pakistani'). Example: {"term": {"NAT_CDENUM": "Pakistani"}}

moi-sponsor-details-v1.SPONSOR_QID: Sponsor Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.
moi-sponsor-details-v1.SPONSORED_QID: Sponsored person Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.
moi-sponsor-details-v1.FIRST_ENTRY_DATE: Date sponsored person first entered Qatar. Date field. Example: {"range": {"FIRST_ENTRY_DATE": {"gte": "2020-01-01"}}}
moi-sponsor-details-v1.MDS_DPTENGNAM: Department name in English. Text field.

moi-relationship-details-v1.HUSBAND_QID_NO: Husband Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.
moi-relationship-details-v1.WIFE_QID_NO: Wife Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.
moi-relationship-details-v1.MARRIAGE_DATE: Marriage date. Date field. Example married after 2015: {"range": {"MARRIAGE_DATE": {"gte": "2015-01-01"}}}
moi-relationship-details-v1.DIVORCE_DATE: Divorce date if applicable. Date field. Null if still married.

moi-visa-application-details-v1.APL_PRSQIDNO: Applicant Qatar ID. Links to person index via prs_qid.
moi-visa-application-details-v1.APL_TYPCDE: Application type code. Same as visa type codes.
